sourceWork: Seven Sorrows and Seven Joys of Saint Joseph
commentary: The numbers 115 and 300 are edition-specific references to this devotion. Entry 301 in 1910 is a distinct generic Novena of St Joseph, not the seven-sorrow exercise. Never label the exercise a nine-day source form.
sevenPartBasis: 1910 §300, seven Roman-numeral prayer paragraphs followed individually by Pater, Ave, Gloria, then closing antiphon, ℣, ℟, collect.

mysteries.joy: Jesus' presence and the overthrow of Egypt's idols in the devotional text
mysteries.scripturalCaution: The fall of the Egyptian idols is a devotional/hagiographic tradition, not stated in Matthew 2; do not display it as a direct biblical verse.

mysteries.sorrow: Fear of Archelaus after the return from Egypt
mysteries.joy: Reassurance and family life at Nazareth

mysteries.sorrow: Loss of the Child Jesus for three days

afterAllParts: Antiphon: Jesus Himself was about thirty years old, being, as was supposed, the son of Joseph
Versicle: Pray for us, holy Joseph
Response: That we may be made worthy of the promises of Christ
Collect: O God, who in Thine ineffable providence didst vouchsafe to choose blessed Joseph ...
